tool.name: FX Replay
tool.description: FX Replay is a browser tool for replaying historical charts and practising entries away from a live account. It also includes a journal and an analytics dashboard. A free plan is available.
features: Journal, checklists and an analytics dashboard
Higher plans raise session, indicator and chart limits
The Pro plan adds seconds-level data plus futures and CME data

plans.name: Beginner
plans.detail: Limited sessions, one indicator and one week of data retention.

plans.name: Intermediate
plans.detail: Or $15/mo when billed at $180 per year.

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: Or $29.16/mo when billed at $350 per year.

tool.pricing_note: Prices from the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. The page says taxes may apply.
